description: This file defines types and functions for discovering gateway beacons via DNS-SD, Avahi, and Tailnet DNS, including parsing and network probing logic.

methods.name: resolveGatewayDiscoveryEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves a GatewayBonjourBeacon to a network endpoint with scheme and URL.

methods.name: pickResolvedGatewayHost
methods.description: Returns the host from a resolved gateway endpoint.

methods.name: pickResolvedGatewayPort
methods.description: Returns the port from a resolved gateway endpoint.

methods.name: discoverGatewayBeacons
methods.description: Discovers gateway beacons using DNS-SD, Avahi, or Tailnet DNS depending on platform.
